quests.instruction: This animal says "Hiss"! Which one is it?
quests.question: Hiss
quests.hint: Think of an animal that lives slithering through the grass.
quests.explanation: Yes! A snake says "Hiss". It also has a long body with no legs at all.
quests.funFact: Snakes grow new skin and shed the old skin as they grow!

quests.instruction: Which animal says "Honk"?
quests.question: Honk
quests.hint: Think of an animal that lives on a farm pond.
quests.explanation: Yes! A goose says "Honk". It also has a long neck and orange webbed feet.
quests.funFact: Geese often fly together in a big letter V shape!

quests.instruction: One of these animals is a bird. Which one?
quests.question: Bird
quests.hint: This animal has huge round eyes and silent wings.
quests.explanation: Yes! The owl is a bird. It lives in a tree in a quiet forest.
quests.funFact: Owls can fly almost silently to sneak up on food!

quests.instruction: Look at the choices. Which animal eats both plants and meat?
quests.question: Eats Everything
quests.hint: This animal lives in a den in the forest.
quests.explanation: Correct! The bear eats both plants and meat. It has thick fur and sharp claws.
quests.funFact: Bears have an amazing sense of smell for finding food!

quests.instruction: One of these animals lives in the jungle. Which one?
quests.question: In the jungle
quests.hint: Look for the animal with a very long neck and long legs.
quests.explanation: Great job! The giraffe lives in the jungle. You can spot it by a very long neck and long legs.
quests.funFact: A giraffe's tongue can be almost as long as your arm!

quests.instruction: One of these animals is a mammal. Which one?
quests.question: Mammal
quests.hint: This animal has orange fur with black stripes.
quests.explanation: Yes! The tiger is a mammal. It lives prowling through the jungle.
quests.funFact: A tiger's stripes help it hide among tall grass!

quests.instruction: Which animal says "Hoot"?
quests.question: Hoot
quests.hint: Think of an animal that lives in a tree in a quiet forest.
quests.explanation: Yes! An owl says "Hoot". It also has huge round eyes and silent wings.
quests.funFact: Owls are awake at night and sleep during the day!

quests.instruction: Which animal can flutter and fly?
quests.question: Flutter and fly
quests.hint: This animal lives fluttering over garden flowers.
quests.explanation: Yes! The butterfly can flutter and fly. It has two pairs of colorful, patterned wings.
quests.funFact: Butterflies taste flowers using their tiny feet!

quests.instruction: Which animal lives in the jungle?
quests.question: In the jungle
quests.hint: Look for the animal with orange fur with black stripes.
quests.explanation: Great job! The tiger lives in the jungle. You can spot it by orange fur with black stripes.
quests.funFact: No two tigers have the exact same stripe pattern!

quests.instruction: Which animal is a bird?
quests.question: Bird
quests.hint: This animal has webbed feet made for paddling.
quests.explanation: Yes! The duck is a bird. It lives on a farm near the water.
quests.funFact: Ducks have waterproof feathers, so they never get soggy!

quests.instruction: Look carefully! Which animal has thick fur and sharp claws?
quests.question: Thick fur and sharp claws
quests.hint: This animal usually lives in a den in the forest.
quests.explanation: That's right! The bear has thick fur and sharp claws. You can find it in a den in the forest.
quests.funFact: Baby bear cubs stay close to their mother to learn and grow!

quests.instruction: Look carefully. Which animal here is a mammal?
quests.question: Mammal
quests.hint: This animal has a fluffy woolly coat.
quests.explanation: Yes! The sheep is a mammal. It lives on a green farm.
quests.funFact: Sheep have excellent memories and can recognize faces!

quests.instruction: Can you find the animal that lives in the jungle?
quests.question: In the jungle
quests.hint: Look for the animal with black and white stripes from head to tail.
quests.explanation: Great job! The zebra lives in the jungle. You can spot it by black and white stripes from head to tail.
quests.funFact: No two zebras have exactly the same stripe pattern!

quests.instruction: Can you spot the animal with a hard round shell on the back?
quests.question: A hard round shell on the back
quests.hint: This animal usually lives paddling in a calm pond.
quests.explanation: That's right! The turtle has a hard round shell on the back. You can find it paddling in a calm pond.
quests.funFact: Some turtles can live for more than 100 years!

quests.instruction: Which animal is a mammal?
quests.question: Mammal
quests.hint: This animal has soft whiskers and sharp little claws.
quests.explanation: Yes! The cat is a mammal. It lives in a cozy home as a pet.
quests.funFact: Cats can make over 100 different sounds!

quests.instruction: One of these animals is a mammal. Which one?
quests.question: Mammal
quests.hint: This animal has a very long neck and long legs.
quests.explanation: Yes! The giraffe is a mammal. It lives reaching up on the plains.
quests.funFact: Giraffes have the same number of neck bones as people—just seven!

quests.instruction: Which animal has shiny orange scales and gentle fins?
quests.question: Shiny orange scales and gentle fins
quests.hint: This animal usually lives swimming in a bowl or a pond.
quests.explanation: That's right! The goldfish has shiny orange scales and gentle fins. You can find it swimming in a bowl or a pond.
quests.funFact: A goldfish breathes underwater using body parts called gills!

quests.instruction: Who is able to run fast to chase? Choose the right animal!
quests.question: Run fast to chase
quests.hint: This animal lives prowling the wild savanna grasslands.
quests.explanation: Yes! The lion can run fast to chase. It has a big furry mane around the face.
quests.funFact: Lions sleep for as many as 20 hours a day!

quests.instruction: One of these animals is a mammal. Which one?
quests.question: Mammal
quests.hint: This animal has a curly tail and a round pink nose.
quests.explanation: Yes! The pig is a mammal. It lives on a muddy farm.
quests.funFact: Pigs are very smart, even smarter than most dogs!

quests.instruction: Who is able to swim by flicking a tail fin? Choose the right animal!
quests.question: Swim by flicking a tail fin
quests.hint: This animal lives swimming in a bowl or a pond.
quests.explanation: Yes! The goldfish can swim by flicking a tail fin. It has shiny orange scales and gentle fins.
quests.funFact: Goldfish often swim together in a big group called a school!

quests.instruction: Who is able to waddle and fly in a line? Choose the right animal!
quests.question: Waddle and fly in a line
quests.hint: This animal lives on a farm pond.
quests.explanation: Yes! The goose can waddle and fly in a line. It has a long neck and orange webbed feet.
quests.funFact: Geese usually stay with the same partner for life!

quests.instruction: One of these animals is a reptile. Which one?
quests.question: Reptile
quests.hint: This animal has a hard round shell on the back.
quests.explanation: Yes! The turtle is a reptile. It lives paddling in a calm pond.
quests.funFact: A turtle can pull its head and legs inside its shell to stay safe!

quests.instruction: Which animal is a mammal?
quests.question: Mammal
quests.hint: This animal has a very long trunk and big flappy ears.
quests.explanation: Yes! The elephant is a mammal. It lives in the wild jungle.
quests.funFact: Elephants are the largest land animals on Earth!

quests.instruction: Which animal can walk with long, graceful strides?
quests.question: Walk with long, graceful strides
quests.hint: This animal lives reaching up on the plains.
quests.explanation: Yes! The giraffe can walk with long, graceful strides. It has a very long neck and long legs.
quests.funFact: Giraffes have the same number of neck bones as people—just seven!

quests.instruction: Which animal makes its home on a farm?
quests.question: On a farm
quests.hint: Look for the animal with short horns and a little beard.
quests.explanation: Great job! The goat lives on a farm. You can spot it by short horns and a little beard.
quests.funFact: A baby goat is called a kid!

quests.instruction: Which animal has long floppy ears and a fluffy round tail?
quests.question: Long floppy ears and a fluffy round tail
quests.hint: This animal usually lives in a burrow in the forest.
quests.explanation: That's right! The rabbit has long floppy ears and a fluffy round tail. You can find it in a burrow in the forest.
quests.funFact: A rabbit's big ears help it hear danger from far away!

quests.instruction: Look carefully. Which animal here is an insect?
quests.question: Insect
quests.hint: This animal has two pairs of colorful, patterned wings.
quests.explanation: Yes! The butterfly is an insect. It lives fluttering over garden flowers.
quests.funFact: Some butterflies fly thousands of miles to a warmer home!

quests.instruction: Can you spot the animal with a long body with no legs at all?
quests.question: A long body with no legs at all

quests.explanation: That's right! The snake has a long body with no legs at all. It says "Hiss".
quests.funFact: Snakes grow new skin and shed the old skin as they grow!

quests.hint: This animal usually lives reaching up on the plains.
quests.explanation: That's right! The giraffe has a very long neck and long legs. You can find it reaching up on the plains.
quests.funFact: Giraffes have the same number of neck bones as people—just seven!

quests.instruction: Who is able to run and pounce? Choose the right animal!
quests.question: Run and pounce
quests.hint: This animal lives prowling through the jungle.
quests.explanation: Yes! The tiger can run and pounce. It has orange fur with black stripes.
quests.funFact: No two tigers have the exact same stripe pattern!
